provenance.identification: Browser-confirmed v19 file-preview downloads; no original v19 archive retained.

path_policy: All retained paths are original archive-relative paths, or original direct-download filenames for v19.

policy: No audio, images, video, PCM/PWM samples or encoded voice streams.
No binary executables, ROM images, voice-trained models or dictionaries.
No generated assembly, per-recording JSON, logs or caches.
No chat transcripts, identifiers, URLs or MIDI.
Only generic code, source/release READMEs and anonymous technical comparison CSVs are retained.

material_gaps: Source-only snapshot; media, binary executables, trained models/dictionaries and generated per-recording data are deliberately absent.
Preserved source has not been executed; historical quality, hardware timing and reproducibility claims have not been revalidated.
Only pitch.py and study_pitch.py were recovered; this is not a complete original v19 release or archive.
